summary: Authored exactly eight unique Projects B geometry definitions as deterministic code-native 2.5D SVG configurations. Each definition preserves its selected primary topology, uses the frozen projection and palette slots, keeps the complete exterior in tier 0, stores recomputed literal identity hashes, and encodes no employer color, placement, factual claim, runtime bitmap, dependency, or product integration. This report does not claim integration, downstream acceptance, promotion, or art-guide coordinate equivalence.
